response.sql: SELECT scans.zoneref, sites.phasefactor, AVG(scans.scancount), AVG(scans.pressratio) FROM scans INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.scancount > 11 GROUP BY scans.zoneref, sites.phasefactor ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(scans.pressratio) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, AVG(scans.pressratio) DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "Ignoring missing values" refers to NULL values, which AVG() automatically excludes from its calculation
"Scancount is more than 11" means strictly greater than (> 11), not greater than or equal to
